metadata.title: Clinical Data Protection

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for ensuring the integrity, confidentiality, and appropriate use of clinical data produced by medical devices.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Clinical data systems, medical device data paths, and regulated health information environments.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for protecting the accuracy, privacy, and clinical suitability of data produced and consumed by medical devices.

props.name: safety-principle
props.remarks: Incorrect or exposed clinical data can directly cause patient harm and unsafe clinical decisions.

props.name: threat-framework
props.remarks: Threat context for attacks that manipulate, corrupt, or exfiltrate clinical data from medical devices.

props.name: defense-framework
props.remarks: Defensive intent focused on protecting data integrity, confidentiality, and access appropriateness in clinical contexts.

metadata.remarks: Clinical Data Protection defines how data generated by medical devices is protected to ensure accuracy, confidentiality, and proper use within clinical workflows. This pattern treats clinical data protection as a patient safety requirement rather than a purely informational security concern.

components.title: Clinical Data Integrity
components.description: Protection against alteration, corruption, or spoofing of medical device data used in clinical decision-making.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Clinical data generated by medical devices is protected against unauthorized modification or corruption.

components.title: Clinical Data Confidentiality
components.description: Protection of sensitive clinical and patient data from unauthorized disclosure.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Clinical data is protected from unauthorized access or disclosure in accordance with health privacy obligations.

components.title: Clinical Data Access Policy
components.description: Enforcement of role- and context-appropriate access to medical device data within clinical workflows.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Access to clinical data is constrained to authorized roles and appropriate clinical contexts.
